sections.html:
Palm Tree became an Orange County town on January 1, 2019, and its borders match the village of Kiryas Joel exactly. Voters approved the split from the Town of Monroe in a referendum on November 7, 2017, and a 2018 state law moved the start date up by a year. In 2019 residents also chose a single consolidated town and village government that operates like a village.

The footprint is only 1.5 square miles, so the population is dense: the April 2020 count was 32,954 and the mid-2025 estimate of 47,147 is 43.1 percent above that base.

Deeds, tax maps and surveys from before 2019 may name Monroe or the village, while newer records name Palm Tree. Check that the deed, the tax bill and the survey all describe your lot the same way before you list.

Palm Tree has 7,505 households averaging 5.08 people. Only 33.4 percent live in a home they own, owner-occupied houses carry a median value of $758,800, and median rent is $1,604 a month. Owners pay a median of $2,616 a month with a mortgage and $1,075 without, and median household income is $50,032.

Appraisers look at how each unit is used, so keep floor plans, unit counts and rent figures handy.

Many residents speak a language other than English at home, and some prefer paper copies to email. If a seller or buyer wants another language or paper documents, tell your attorney and title company at the start. The disclosure form, contract and closing statement can then be explained in a way everyone follows, and signing will not depend on online portals.

Deeds are recorded at the Orange County Clerk's Record Room, on the second floor of the Government Center at 255 Main Street in Goshen. Documents on file there include deeds, mortgages, mortgage satisfactions, federal tax liens, judgments and lis pendens.

  • Office computers let the public search at no cost, and an online search site is also available.
  • Copies run 65 cents a page plain (minimum $1.30) and $1.25 a page certified (minimum $5.00).
  • Your own deed costs about $5 from the clerk, and the office cautions against outside firms that bill for the same copy.
  • A free Fraud Alert sign-up sends a notice whenever a deed or mortgage is filed under your name.

The clerk's office also provides notary services free of charge, which helps when a deed needs an acknowledgment. Search for judgments and liens against your name before you list. A seller who finds one early can arrange the payoff, and the title search will turn it up anyway.

Orange County gives a general pattern, and the local tax collector gives the exact dates. Call your municipality's tax collector for a precise schedule.

Usual Orange County collection periods
Type of tax billUsual collection period
County and townJanuary through March
SchoolSeptember through November
VillageJune through October

Because Palm Tree and Kiryas Joel are the same territory, ask the tax collector which of these bills apply to your parcel. Questions about delinquent amounts and penalties go to the county finance office at 845-291-2480.

Most communities in the state hold Grievance Day on the fourth Tuesday in May, so verify the date with your assessor. A complaint on Form RP-524 goes to the assessor or the review board at no charge, and only the current tentative roll can be contested. Ask Palm Tree's assessor for next year's date.

The state taxes each $500 slice of the price at two dollars, with partial slices rounded up, and the seller pays unless the contract moves it.

Form TP-584 is the combined return. File it with the county clerk by the 15th day after the deed changes hands, with the tax. A buyer owes a further 1 percent mansion tax if the residence costs $1 million or more.

Investors should note a separate rule. If an LLC sits on either side of a deal for a building of up to four units, the return is not accepted without names and addresses of its members, managers and authorized persons, and any member that is itself a business must be traced down to individuals. Collect those details before closing day.

On a typical closing day, your attorney or title company prepares the deed and the TP-584, collects the transfer tax from your proceeds, and files everything at the Orange County Clerk in Goshen. Ask beforehand who will carry the documents, and request a copy of the filed deed afterward for your records.

sections.h2: Which questions on the state form matter when a Palm Tree house is rented?
sections.html:
Before the buyer signs, the owner of a house with up to four units must supply the state's seller disclosure form. Selling as is remains allowed, and the form is no warranty.

Question 4 asks whether anyone besides the owner has a lease, easement or other right to use or occupy any part of the property. Since only 33.4 percent of households here own their homes, buyers tend to ask about leases and rents early, so pull together copies and a rent roll. Other topics on the form include certificates of occupancy, shared walls or driveways, flood zones, water and sewage service, detectors, and the roof, heating and plumbing.

With the town and village governments merged, ask Palm Tree town hall which office issues building permits and certificates of occupancy for your street. Get the reply in writing if work was done on the house.

Owners with a deadline, deferred repairs or occupied units sometimes prefer a cash sale. Without a lender, closing turns on payoff letters, title clearance and recording in Goshen. Ask for terms in writing, find out who covers each transfer cost, and have a New York lawyer review the contract.

Prepare ahead. Gather your deed, the latest tax bills, copies of leases and a rent roll if any unit is occupied, and payoff letters for loans or liens. A buyer who sees complete records can order title work immediately, which keeps the closing date from slipping. If a lease runs past the planned closing, say so in the first conversation, since it changes who can move in and when.

faqs.q: Is Palm Tree just another name for Kiryas Joel?
faqs.a: Their boundaries match. Palm Tree took over the village's territory when it separated from Monroe on January 1, 2019. A deed may name either one, so confirm which description your title company uses.

faqs.q: Where does a Palm Tree deed get recorded?
faqs.a: In Goshen, with the Orange County Clerk, whose Record Room is on the second floor of the Government Center at 255 Main Street. Owners can also enroll in the clerk's free Fraud Alert.

faqs.q: How is the state transfer tax figured on a Palm Tree sale?
faqs.a: At two dollars per $500 of price, rounded up. The seller normally covers it. A buyer owes the 1 percent mansion tax only when a residence reaches $1 million, and the TP-584 return and payment go to the county clerk within 15 days of delivery.

faqs.q: Which months does Orange County use to collect county and town tax?
faqs.a: Mostly January to March, with school bills running September to November. Periods vary by municipality, so the Palm Tree tax collector has the final schedule for your bill.

faqs.q: Do tenants have to be listed on the form for a Palm Tree house?
faqs.a: In effect, yes. Question 4 asks whether anyone other than the owner has a lease or a right to use or occupy any part of the property. Answer from your own knowledge, attach extra pages if needed, and hand the form over before the contract is signed.
